meta.name: game-concept
meta.description: Design game concepts from a novel. From SOURCE_BIBLE and PRODUCT_BRIEF, generate three genuinely different directions on the dimensions still unlocked, then pick the most worthwhile playable prototype using hard vetoes and explicit trade-offs. Use for what game should this novel become, compare game concepts, choose a game direction for this book. 小说游戏概念设计。根据 SOURCE_BIBLE 与 PRODUCT_BRIEF 在未锁定维度上生成三个真正不同的方案，用硬否决和关键取舍选择最值得做的可玩原型。用于判断小说适合做成什么游戏、比较游戏方案等需求。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 生成三种游戏方案并挑出最值得做的可玩原型
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你有小说版权,想理性选定改编成哪种游戏
copy.tagline_en: Generate three game concepts and pick the most worthwhile playable prototype
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you own a novel IP and need a rational game direction choice.

howto.what: 为小说生成游戏概念：先要求提供 SOURCE_BIBLE 和 PRODUCT_BRIEF，缺一即停；齐备后给出三个不同方向，经硬否决和取舍选一个，写入 concepts/CONCEPT.md。
howto.when: 当用户要求判断某部小说适合做成什么游戏、比较游戏概念或选择游戏方向时触发；需提供 SOURCE_BIBLE 与 PRODUCT_BRIEF，缺任一即停止。

say.text: 基于 SOURCE_BIBLE 与 PRODUCT_BRIEF，给三个游戏方向。
say.note: 会产出三个方向并选一个。

say.text: 比较这几个游戏概念，哪个更适合先做可玩原型？
say.note: 会做硬否决后给推荐，不计算总分。

say.text: 判断这部小说适合做什么游戏，并把结论写成 CONCEPT.md。
say.note: 最终会输出一份概念文档。

howto.what_en: When enabled, Claude checks for SOURCE_BIBLE and PRODUCT_BRIEF and stops if either is missing. With both, it generates three distinct game-concept directions, applies hard vetoes and trade-offs to select one, and writes concepts/CONCEPT.md.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user asks which game a novel should become, compares game concepts, or chooses a direction for a book. Requires SOURCE_BIBLE and PRODUCT_BRIEF; stops if either is absent.

say_en.text: Based on SOURCE_BIBLE and PRODUCT_BRIEF, give three game directions.
say_en.note: It will produce three directions and pick one.

say_en.text: Compare these game concepts: which one is more suitable to prototype first?
say_en.note: It applies hard vetoes and gives a recommendation, not a total score.

say_en.text: Decide what game this novel should become and write the conclusion to CONCEPT.md.
say_en.note: It will output a concept document.
